business_model.claim: PACS provides skilled nursing care, assisted living, and independent living services to post-acute patients who have been discharged from hospitals and require 24-hour in-patient services.
quotes: We are a leading post-acute healthcare company primarily focused on delivering high-quality skilled nursing care through a portfolio of independently operated facilities.
We also provide senior care, assisted living, and independent living options in some of our communities.

business_model.claim: Revenue is paid by third-party payors, with Medicare and Medicaid being the largest sources, accounting for 33.7% and 40.5% of routine revenue in fiscal year 2025, respectively.
quotes: A substantial portion of our revenue is generated from payments from third-party payors, including Medicare and Medicaid, which represent our largest sources of revenue and accounted for 33.7% and 40.5% of our routine revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025, respectively.

business_model.claim: Patient and resident service revenue represents over 99% of total revenue; other revenue (primarily facility leasing) is immaterial.
quotes: Patient and resident service revenue typically represents over 99% of our total revenue.
Other revenue typically represents an immaterial portion of our total revenue and we expect this to continue for the foreseeable future.

quotes: As of June 30, 2026, our portfolio consisted of 324 post-acute care, assisted living, and independent living facilities across 17 states serving 31,900 patients daily.

business_model.basis: stated in P3 (10-K Item 7 MD&A – Key Skilled Services Metrics)
business_model.claim: Revenue is driven by skilled mix (the share of high-acuity Medicare and managed-care patient days versus lower-acuity Medicaid days), occupancy rate, and total volume of patient days.
quotes: Skilled mix by revenue represents the portion of routine revenue generated from treating high acuity Medicare and managed care patients.
Occupancy — The total number of patients occupying a bed in a skilled nursing facility as a percentage of the beds in such facility that are available for occupancy during the period.

quotes: Our cost of services represents the costs of operating our operating subsidiaries, which primarily consist of payroll and related benefits, supplies, purchased services, and ancillary expenses such as the cost of pharmacy and therapy services provided to patients.

business_model.basis: stated in P1 (10-K Item 1 Business – Disciplined Acquisition Playbook)
business_model.claim: PACS's growth strategy is to acquire underperforming long-term custodial-care SNFs and convert them into higher-acuity, higher-value short-term transitional-care SNFs over a three-year post-acquisition transition period.

Our facilities generally undergo an up to three-year post-acquisition transition period.
